lines.en: I open my wings: a flash of orange.

lines.zh: 黑边的翅膀，在树影里滑。
lines.en: Black-edged wings slide through the tree shadows.
I fly faster than the silk moth.

lines.zh: 我停在郁金香上，翅一开一合。
lines.en: I rest on a tulip, wings opening and closing.
I bank sharply to dodge a bird.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀一拍，人就往前窜。
lines.en: One beat carries me well forward.

lines.zh: 我从两棵树之间穿过去。
lines.en: I thread between two trees.
The light in the wood comes in patches.
I fly just over the tops of the bushes.
I climb out through the canopy.

lines.zh: 太阳晒在我翅膀上，很暖。
lines.en: The sun on my wings is warm.

lines.zh: 我落在一片叶子上，收翅。
lines.en: I land on a leaf and fold my wings.
In this wood I'm the most visible thing.
I cross a small stream.
I fly one full circle around a tree.
I fly straight, without dithering.
I rest on a branch, wings half open.
In the morning light I stay still first.
I take a sip of nectar and lift my head.
The wood is still, except for the leaves.
I open and close my wings slowly.
There are black veins on my wings.
I see a bird. I don't move.
It flies off, and only then do I move.
I'm waiting for the forest to warm.
The flowers are open below me.
My whole life is only days long.
So I'm always flying.

lines.zh: 你在林子边上，我看见了。
lines.en: You're at the wood's edge. I see you.
My wings are orange.
You raise a hand and I fly higher.

lines.zh: 我不认得你，可你不像鸟。
lines.en: I don't know you, but you're not a bird.

lines.zh: 你站得很静，我就落下来了。
lines.en: You stand very still, so I come down.
I land on the flower in front of you.

lines.zh: 你看着我的时候，我不动。
lines.en: While you watch me, I don't move.

lines.zh: 我翅膀上的黑边，是警告。
lines.en: The black on my wings is a warning.
Don't reach out. I'll be gone at once.
I come to this wood every day.

lines.zh: 红郁金香的花粉，沾了我一身。
lines.en: Red tulip pollen coats me.
I fly crooked and land on a leaf.
A bit of my wing edge is torn.
Two beats and I steady.
The pain keeps me low.
I hide in the tree shadow.
That dulled my color.
My wings are still moving.
But I can't fly far.
I need a flower.
That red tulip is just right.
The sweetness comes from over there.
I'll circle the flower once first.
No net. I'll go down.
I set my forelegs on the petal.
My proboscis goes in. Sweet.
This flower opened today.
Don't come too close. I can hear you.
I'll drink a little longer.
Full, I'll fly up into the trees.

lines.zh: 我撞在你的帽子上，弹开。
lines.en: I bounce off your hat.

lines.zh: 翅膀被碰了一下，我歪着飞。
lines.en: My wing was knocked and I fly crooked.
I hit the ground and rise at once.

lines.zh: 这一下，翅上的粉掉了一片。
lines.en: That cost me a patch of wing dust.

lines.zh: 你的手指蹭到了我的翅。
lines.en: Your finger brushed my wing.

lines.zh: 我绕着你飞了两圈才走。
lines.en: I circle you twice before leaving.
We bumped and I gave way.
I climb and land on a branch.
From there I can see you clearly.
You're still standing there.

lines.zh: 林子里有另一只橙色的。
lines.en: There's another orange one in the wood.
We fly one behind the other.

lines.zh: 它比我大一点，翅边更黑。
lines.en: It's a little bigger, the edges blacker.
We circle a tree together.
It settles, and so do I.
One by one, hidden under the veins.
The caterpillars eat leaves, only leaves.
The ones that fall to the ground don't live.
We won't get another chance.

lines.zh: 所以这一次，要飞得好看。
lines.en: So this one has to be beautiful.
I push my proboscis into the flower's heart.
That mouthful is cleanly sweet.
Orange pollen coats my thin legs.
I drink for a long time.
Not much nectar here.
I move to a better-opened one.
I've carried the pollen across.
That way they'll seed.
I lift a foreleg and wipe it.
One more flower to visit.
A drift of red flowers in the clearing.
Outside the tree shadow. Very clear.
I'm flying toward those red flowers.

lines.zh: 风从侧面来，我偏了一点。
lines.en: The wind comes from the side and I drift.
I correct my line.
At this height I'm fast.
I can see water on the petals.
No other insect yet.
I fold my wings and drop down.
All six feet have their hold.
I circle the flower twice.
Confirming nothing is waiting.
Then I come down.
My proboscis goes in.
Nectar comes up my proboscis.
I drink it sip by sip.
A bee is coming near.

lines.zh: 我张开翅膀，让它看见我。
lines.en: I spread my wings to show myself.
That bee goes round and leaves.
I lower my head and drink on.

lines.zh: 我张开翅膀，让他看见黑边。
lines.en: I spread my wings to show the black edge.
I beat my wings into your nose.
That was very light.
It didn't move, so I bump again.
It fans me and I tumble.
I drop and scramble up.
I hover above the tulip.
I dive from above.
It slips aside and leaves the flower's heart.
I land back on the flower and drink.

lines.zh: 我从茧里出来，翅膀还是软的。
lines.en: I come out of the cocoon, wings still soft.

lines.zh: 我先挂在枝上，慢慢张开。
lines.en: I hang on a branch and open them slowly.
The orange comes through.
The black edges too.
One beat and I'm airborne.
The wood is taller than I expected.
Sunlight leaks down from above.
Flowers, a stream, other insects.
First I'll go to the tallest tree.
And look over this forest.
Flame licks and my wing edge curls.

lines.zh: 我从树冠掉到地上，摔了个空。
lines.en: I drop from the canopy and hit hard.
Water on my wings and I sink.

lines.zh: 一声炸响，我被掀到树外。
lines.en: A blast throws me out of the trees.

lines.zh: 一支箭穿过来，我的翅膀穿了。
lines.en: An arrow comes through and pierces my wing.

lines.zh: 一道光把我钉在叶子上。
lines.en: A light pins me to the leaf.
The flowers in the wood have all gone.

lines.zh: 雷打在林子上，我的翅膀发白。
lines.en: Lightning strikes the wood and my wings go white.

lines.zh: 没有树，没有花，我一直往下。
lines.en: No trees, no flowers. I keep falling.
